title: Report: GTA 6: Arthur Morgan’s Hat Location from Red Dead Redemption 2
description: VideoGamesChronicle details how to buy Arthur Morgan's iconic hat from a yard sale in GTA 6 for $35, available from Chapter 2 near Port Gellhorn. GamesRadar corroborates the location and price, while Rockstar has not officially commented on the crossover Easter egg.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6: Where to Find Arthur Morgan's Hat (RDR2 Easter Egg) Location Guide
socialHook: Arthur Morgan's hat from Red Dead Redemption 2 can be bought for $35 at a yard sale in GTA 6.

sections.heading: How to Obtain Arthur Morgan’s Hat in GTA 6
paragraphs: VideoGamesChronicle reports that Arthur Morgan’s iconic hat from Red Dead Redemption 2 appears in Grand Theft Auto 6 as a wearable cosmetic item called the Genuine Cowboy Hat, which can be purchased for $35 at a specific yard sale location.

sections.heading: Location, Requirements, and Character Restrictions
paragraphs: The yard sale is located on the southern edge of Port Gellhorn, a short distance south of Moses’ chop shop, and becomes accessible during daytime from Chapter 2 onward; each protagonist can buy the hat only once, so players must choose whether Jason or Lucia will wear it.

sections.heading: Additional Coverage and Unconfirmed Details
paragraphs: GamesRadar published a similar guide on the same day corroborating the location and price, though neither outlet confirms whether the hat is a brand‑new replica or an aged original, and Rockstar Games has not officially commented on the crossover Easter egg.
